title: Creditor updated
description: This event occurs when a creditor is updated.

id.title: Creditor identifier
id.description: This field contains the identifier of the updated creditor.

name.title: Creditor name
name.description: This field contains the creditor name, or null when the creditor has no name.

advancement_fee.title: Advancement fee
advancement_fee.description: This field contains the advancement fee rate of the creditor, or null when not set.

discount_rate.title: Discount rate
discount_rate.description: This field contains the discount rate of the creditor, or null when not set.

maximum_advancement_percentage.title: Maximum advancement percentage
maximum_advancement_percentage.description: This field contains the maximum advancement percentage of the creditor, or null when not set.

crediting_method.title: Crediting method
crediting_method.description: This field contains how the creditor is credited. ACCOUNT means a Pismo account is credited and account_id is set; NONE means no account crediting and account_id is null.

account_id.title: Account identifier
account_id.description: This field contains the Pismo account credited for the creditor, or null when crediting_method is NONE.
